## Activity

The reporting period for Hill Counties Health Centre was November 2018. During this period, the site recorded 87 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. The activity level should be considered alongside the results described below, including the number of images that could not be graded and the number assessed as referable.

## Image quality

Of the 87 captures, 5 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.7. This result identifies the proportion of captured images for which grading could not be completed. The image quality outcome should continue to be monitored through routine site reporting so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

There were 8 referable results during November 2018. The median lag for grading was 6. This measure provides an indication of the typical time between capture and completion of grading. Together, the referable results and grading lag describe the service outcome for the reporting period. These findings should be reviewed as part of ongoing local oversight, with attention to maintaining timely grading and supporting consistent image capture.
